AnnotationJson.description:
JSON representation of a PDF annotation.

This struct represents a non-link annotation from a PDF page, such as
highlights, text notes, stamps, free text, ink drawings, lines, polygons,
and file attachments.

Per the plan (Phase 7.6.3), annotations are extracted after links and
form fields, with sorting for deterministic output.

author.description:
The annotation's author from the /T entry.

None if /T is missing or not a string.

color.description:
The color array from /C as RGB/Grayscale components.

None if /C is missing. Length is 1 (grayscale), 3 (RGB), or 4 (CMYK).

contents.description:
The annotation's content text from /Contents.

None if /Contents is missing or not a string.

modified.description:
The modification date from /M as an ISO 8601 string.

None if /M is missing, malformed, or fails to parse.
Format: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"

name_id.description:
The name identifier from /NM.

None if /NM is missing.

opacity.description:
The opacity from /CA.

None if /CA is missing.

rect.description:
The bounding rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF user-space units.

None if the /Rect entry is missing or invalid.

specific.description:
Subtype-specific fields.

Present only for annotation types that have additional data beyond
the common fields. For unsupported subtypes, this is null.

subject.description:
The subject from /Subj.

None if /Subj is missing.

AnnotationSpecificJson.description:
Subtype-specific annotation fields.

This enum captures the additional data present in specific annotation subtypes.

oneOf.description:
Text markup annotations (Highlight, Underline, StrikeOut, Squiggly).

Contains the quadpoint arrays defining the marked regions.

quads.description:
Array of quadpoint arrays [x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3] defining the marked regions.

Each quad defines a quadrilateral region in PDF user-space coordinates.

oneOf.description:
Stamp annotations.

Contains the stamp name from /Name.

Free text annotations.

Contains the default appearance string from /DA.

Text annotations (sticky notes).

Contains the open state and state information.

open.description: Whether the note is initially open.

oneOf.description:
Ink annotations (hand-drawn sketches).

Contains the stroke paths.

strokes.description:
Array of stroke paths, where each stroke is an array of points.

Each point is [x, y] in PDF user-space coordinates.

oneOf.description:
Line annotations.

Contains the line endpoints.

endpoints.description: The line endpoints as [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]].

oneOf.description:
Polygon annotations.

Contains the polygon vertices.

vertices.description:
Array of [x, y] vertices defining the polygon.

Each vertex is in PDF user-space coordinates.

oneOf.description:
File attachment annotations.

Contains the file specification reference.

fs_ref.description:
The file specification reference number.

Computed as (object_number << 16 | generation_number) as u32.

AttachmentJson.description:
JSON representation of an embedded file attachment.

Represents a single embedded file extracted from the PDF's `/EmbeddedFiles`
name tree or `/AF` (Associated Files) array.

Per plan (Phase 7.5.3), attachments exceeding 50 MB are truncated
(metadata only, data: null, truncated: true). The `data` field contains
base64-encoded content using RFC 4648 standard alphabet with padding
and no line breaks. The JSON Schema declares `contentEncoding: base64`
for the `data` field, enabling JSON Schema validators and code generation
tools to understand the encoding.

checksum_md5.description:
MD5 checksum from /Params /CheckSum as hex string (None if absent).

Per PDF spec, /CheckSum is a 16-byte binary string (MD5), hex-encoded
as 32 lowercase hex characters.

created.description:
Creation date from /Params /CreationDate as ISO 8601 string (None if absent).

Format: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"

data.description:
Base64-encoded attachment content (null if truncated or empty).

Per JSON Schema, this field has `contentEncoding: base64`, indicating
the string is base64-encoded binary data. Downstream tools can use this
information to automatically decode the content.

- `Some(base64_string)` when content <= 50 MB
- `None` when `truncated: true` (content too large)

In the Python API (PyO3), this field is returned as a `bytes` object
(PyO3 automatically decodes the base64 string).

description.description: Description from /Desc (None if absent, not empty string).

mime_type.description: MIME type from stream /Subtype (None if absent, no guessing from extension).

modified.description:
Modification date from /Params /ModDate as ISO 8601 string (None if absent).

Format: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"

size.description:
Original decoded size in bytes (always populated, even when truncated).

This is the size of the attachment content before base64 encoding.
When `truncated: true`, this represents the full original size that
was not included in the output.

truncated.description:
Whether the attachment content was truncated due to the 50 MB size limit.

When `true`, the `data` field is `None` and only metadata is included.
The `size` field still reflects the original full size.

BlockJson.description:
JSON representation of a structural block.

A block is a higher-level semantic unit composed of one or more
spans. Examples include paragraphs, headings, list items, and
table cells.

bbox.description:
Bounding box in PDF user-space points.

Format: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` where (x0, y0) is the bottom-left
corner and (x1, y1) is the top-right corner.

level.description:
Optional heading level (1-6) for "heading" kind blocks.

This field is present only for heading blocks. For paragraphs
and other block types, it is `null`.

receipt.description:
Optional cryptographic receipt for verification.

This field is present when `--receipts=lite` or `--receipts=svg`
is enabled. When receipts are disabled, the field is `null`.

table_index.description:
Optional table index for "table" kind blocks.

This field is present only for table blocks and points to the
corresponding entry in the page's `tables` array.

text.description: The concatenated text content of all spans in the block.

CellJson.description:
JSON representation of a table cell.

A cell represents a single unit within a table row, containing
its text content, bounding box, and position information.

bbox.description:
Bounding box in PDF user-space points.

Format: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` where (x0, y0) is the bottom-left
corner and (x1, y1) is the top-right corner.

col.description: Zero-based column index within the table.

colspan.description:
Number of columns this cell spans (default 1).

Values greater than 1 indicate a merged cell that spans
multiple columns horizontally.

is_header_row.description:
Whether this cell is in a header row.

Header cells are typically rendered differently (bold, centered)
and may be reused when tables span multiple pages.

row.description: Zero-based row index within the table.

rowspan.description:
Number of rows this cell spans (default 1).

Values greater than 1 indicate a merged cell that spans
multiple rows vertically.

spans.description:
References to spans in the page's `spans` array.

These indices point to the spans that make up this cell's content.

text.description: The concatenated text content of all spans in the cell.

ChoiceValueJson.description:
Choice field value representation.

Choice fields can have either a single selected value or multiple
selected values (for multi-select list boxes).

DestArrayJson.description:
Explicit destination array for internal links.

This struct represents an explicit destination in a PDF, which specifies
a target page and how that page should be displayed (fit type).

dest.description: The fit type and associated coordinates for this destination.

page_index.description: Zero-based page index for this destination.

DestTypeJson.description:
Destination fit type enum.

This enum defines how a page should be displayed when navigating to
a destination. It corresponds to the PDF destination fit types.

oneOf.description:
XYZ destination with optional left, top, and zoom.

Display the page with the coordinates (left, top) positioned at the
upper-left corner of the window and the page contents magnified by
the factor zoom. A null value for any of left, top, or zoom indicates
that the current value of that parameter should be retained unchanged.

left.description:
The left coordinate in PDF user-space units.

Null indicates the current left position should be retained.

top.description:
The top coordinate in PDF user-space units.

Null indicates the current top position should be retained.

zoom.description:
The zoom factor.

Null indicates the current zoom level should be retained.

oneOf.description:
Fit destination — display the page with its contents magnified
just enough to fit the entire page within the window both horizontally
and vertically.

FitH destination with optional top coordinate.

Display the page with the top coordinate positioned at the top edge
of the window and the contents magnified just enough to fit the entire
width of the page within the window.

top.description:
The top coordinate in PDF user-space units.

Null indicates the current top position should be retained.

oneOf.description:
FitV destination with optional left coordinate.

Display the page with the left coordinate positioned at the left edge
of the window and the contents magnified just enough to fit the entire
height of the page within the window.

left.description:
The left coordinate in PDF user-space units.

Null indicates the current left position should be retained.

oneOf.description:
FitR destination with bounding rectangle.

Display the page with the specified rectangle magnified just enough
to fit the entire rectangle within the window both horizontally and
vertically.

bottom.description: The bottom coordinate in PDF user-space units.

left.description: The left coordinate in PDF user-space units.

right.description: The right coordinate in PDF user-space units.

top.description: The top coordinate in PDF user-space units.

oneOf.description:
FitB destination — display the page with its contents magnified
just enough to fit its bounding box entirely within the window both
horizontally and vertically.

FitBH destination with optional top coordinate.

Display the page with the top coordinate positioned at the top edge
of the window and the contents magnified just enough to fit the entire
width of its bounding box within the window.

top.description:
The top coordinate in PDF user-space units.

Null indicates the current top position should be retained.

oneOf.description:
FitBV destination with optional left coordinate.

Display the page with the left coordinate positioned at the left edge
of the window and the contents magnified just enough to fit the entire
height of its bounding box within the window.

left.description:
The left coordinate in PDF user-space units.

Null indicates the current left position should be retained.

LinkJson.description:
JSON representation of a PDF link annotation.

This struct represents a hyperlink from a PDF page, which can point to
a URI, a named destination, or an explicit destination array.

Per the plan (Phase 7.6.2), links are extracted and sorted deterministically
for stable output.

dest.description:
Named destination string (e.g., "Chapter1").

None if the link is not a named destination link.

dest_array.description:
Explicit destination array with page index and fit type.

None if the link is not an explicit destination link.

page_index.description: Zero-based page index containing this link.

rect.description:
The bounding rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF user-space units.

Format: [x0, y0, x1, y1] where (x0, y0) is the bottom-left corner and
(x1, y1) is the top-right corner.

uri.description:
URI string for external links.

None if the link is not a URI link.

cache_age_seconds.description: Cache entry age in seconds (only present when cache_status == "hit")

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics emitted during extraction (coverage warnings, etc.)

error_count.description: Number of pages that failed to extract.

page_count.description: Total number of pages in the document.

reading_order_algorithm.description: Reading order algorithm used for this extraction.

receipts_mode.description: Receipts mode used for this extraction.

FormFieldJson.description:
JSON representation of a form field.

This struct represents a single interactive form field from the PDF's
AcroForm or XFA data, including its type, value, and metadata.

Per the plan (Phase 7.4), form fields are extracted from both AcroForm
and XFA sources, with XFA values taking precedence on collision.

default.description:
The default value (/DV entry) if present.

Matches the structure of `value` but represents the field's default state.

max_length.description:
Maximum length for text fields (/MaxLen entry).
Only present for text fields that have a max length set.

multi_select.description:
Whether this choice field supports multiple selections (bit 21 of /Ff).
Only present for choice fields.

multiline.description:
Whether this text field supports multiple lines (bit 13 of /Ff).
Only present for text fields.

name.description:
The absolute (dot-joined) field name from the AcroForm.
Example: "employer_signature" or "form.employee_sig"

options.description:
Available options for choice fields.

Each option is a [export_value, display_name] pair.
Only present for choice fields.

page_index.description:
Zero-based page index where this field's widget appears.

None if the field has no visual representation (form-only field).

pushbutton.description:
Whether this button is a pushbutton (bit 26 of /Ff).
Only present for button fields.

radio.description:
Whether this button is a radio button (bit 25 of /Ff).
Only present for button fields.

read_only.description: Whether this field is read-only (bit 1 of /Ff flags).

rect.description:
Bounding box in PDF user-space points.

Format: [x0, y0, x1, y1] where (x0, y0) is the bottom-left corner.
None if the field has no visual appearance.

required.description: Whether this field is required (bit 2 of /Ff flags).

selected.description:
Selected state for button fields.
True = checked/selected, False = unchecked.
Only present for button fields.

state_name.description:
Appearance state name for button fields.
E.g., "Yes", "Off", or custom state names.
Only present for button fields.

type.description: The field type variant (text, button, choice, or signature).

value.description:
The current value of the form field.

This field's structure varies by field_type:
- text: string value
- button: boolean selected state
- choice: string or array of strings (for multi-select)
- signature: signature reference number (or null if unsigned)

FormFieldTypeJson.description:
Form field type discriminator.

This enum uses serde's "tag" representation to produce a JSON string
indicating the field type.

oneOf.description: Text field (/FT /Tx) - single-line or multi-line text input.
Button field (/FT /Btn) - pushbutton, checkbox, or radio button.
Choice field (/FT /Ch) - dropdown or list box.
Signature field (/FT /Sig) - digital signature field.

anyOf.description: Choice field value (single string or array of strings for multi-select).
Signature field value (signature reference number or null).

FormFieldValueJson.description:
Form field value representation.

This enum captures the current value of a form field, with the variant
type matching the field_type.

PageResult.description:
Result for a single page.

Contains page geometry, classification, and content arrays (spans, blocks, tables, annotations).

annotations.description:
Non-link annotations on this page (highlights, notes, stamps, etc.).

This array contains all non-link annotations extracted from the page's
/Annots array. Annotations are sorted deterministically by position
(y0 descending, then x0 ascending) for stable output.

blocks.description: Extracted blocks (semantic units like paragraphs, headings).

error.description: Error message if extraction failed for this page.

page_label.description:
Human-readable label from PDF /PageLabels number tree (e.g., "iv", "A-3").

Absent (null) if the PDF defines no page labels.

page_number.description:
One-based page number (= page_index + 1).

Emitted as a convenience for human-facing display. For programmatic
access, use page_index instead.

rotation.description: Page rotation in degrees clockwise (0, 90, 180, or 270).

spans.description: Extracted spans (text fragments with consistent styling).

tables.description:
Extracted tables (cell-level structure).

This array provides detailed table structure with rows and cells.
Table blocks in the `blocks` array reference entries here via `table_index`.

type.description:
Page classification from the page classifier.

One of: "text", "scanned", "mixed", "broken_vector", "blank", "figure_only".

Receipt.description:
A visual citation receipt for extracted text.

Receipts provide cryptographic proof that a piece of extracted text
originated from a specific region in a specific PDF. They can be
verified independently by re-running pdftract on the original file.

# Lite mode

In lite mode, `svg_clip` is `None` and the JSON output does not
include the key at all (via `skip_serializing_if`). This keeps
receipts small (~120-180 bytes) for high-volume use cases like
RAG citation pipelines.

# SVG mode

In SVG mode, `svg_clip` contains a self-contained SVG element
that renders only the glyphs whose bboxes fall within the receipt
bbox. The SVG is normalized to the bbox coordinate system and
can be rendered standalone in any browser.

# Example

```json
{
  "pdf_fingerprint": "pdftract-v1:a7f3...",
  "page_index": 14,
  "bbox": [220.0, 412.0, 412.0, 432.0],
  "content_hash": "sha256:9b21...",
  "extraction_version": "1.0.0"
}
```

bbox.description:
Bounding box in PDF user-space points.

Format: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` where:
- x0, y0: bottom-left corner
- x1, y1: top-right corner
- Units: PDF points (1/72 inch)

This is a copy of the parent span's bbox, included so the
receipt is self-contained.

content_hash.description:
SHA-256 hash of the NFC-normalized text content.

Format: `"sha256:" + hex(SHA-256)`.

The text is normalized to NFC form before hashing to ensure
stability across platforms that may use different Unicode
normalization forms (e.g., macOS HFS+/APFS sometimes round-trips
through NFD).

extraction_version.description:
The pdftract version that produced this receipt.

Format: semver string (e.g., "1.0.0", "1.0.0-rc.1").
Taken from `CARGO_PKG_VERSION` at compile time.

page_index.description:
0-based page index in the source PDF.

Matches the page_index in the extraction schema.

pdf_fingerprint.description:
Phase 1.7 fingerprint of the source PDF.

Format: `"pdftract-v1:" + hex(SHA-256)`.
The verifier compares this string literally (not parsed).

svg_clip.description:
Optional SVG clip rendering the glyphs in this receipt.

- `None` in lite mode (the key is omitted from JSON entirely)
- `Some(svg)` in SVG mode, where `svg` is a self-contained SVG element

The SVG coordinate system is normalized to the bbox itself,
so it renders correctly in isolation.

ReceiptsMode.description:
Receipt generation mode.

Controls whether visual citation receipts are generated during extraction.

oneOf.description: No receipts generated (default).
Lite mode: minimal receipts (~120 bytes each) with fingerprint, page index, bbox, and content hash.
SVG mode: extended receipts that include an SVG clip rendering the glyphs.

RowJson.description:
JSON representation of a table row.

A row contains a sequence of cells that form a horizontal strip
in the table.

bbox.description:
Bounding box in PDF user-space points.

Format: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` where (x0, y0) is the bottom-left
corner and (x1, y1) is the top-right corner.

cells.description: Cells in this row, ordered left-to-right.

is_header.description:
Whether this row is a header row.

Header rows are typically repeated when tables span multiple pages.

SignatureJson.description:
JSON representation of a digital signature.

This struct represents a signature extracted from a PDF signature field,
including signer identity, timestamp, and coverage information.

Per the plan (Phase 7.3), pdftract does NOT perform cryptographic validation
in v1. The `validation_status` field is always "not_checked" — future versions
may add "valid", "invalid", or "indeterminate" as cryptographic validation
is implemented.

byte_range.description:
The /ByteRange array defining which bytes of the file are signed.

Format: array of 4 integers [offset, length, offset, length] defining two byte ranges.
None if /ByteRange is missing or malformed.

coverage_fraction.description:
Fraction of the file covered by the signature (0.0 to 1.0).

Computed as `(byte_range[1] + byte_range[3]) / file_size`.
None if /ByteRange is missing, malformed, or file_size is unknown.

Values < 1.0 indicate partial signatures (a common red flag for tampered docs).

field_name.description:
The absolute (dot-joined) field name from the AcroForm.
Example: "employer_signature" or "form.employee_sig"

location.description:
The location of signing from the /Location entry.

None if /Location is absent.

reason.description:
The reason for signing from the /Reason entry.

None if /Reason is absent.

signer_name.description:
The signer's name from the /Name entry in the signature dictionary.

Empty string if /Name is absent.

signing_date.description:
The signing date as an ISO 8601 string (RFC 3339 format).

Parsed from the PDF /M date string. None if the date is missing,
malformed, or the field is unsigned.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"

sub_filter.description:
The signature format / filter from the /SubFilter entry.

Indicates the signature format: "adbe.pkcs7.detached", "adbe.x509.rsa.sha1", etc.
None if /SubFilter is absent.

validation_status.description:
Validation status — always "not_checked" in v1.

Future versions may add "valid", "invalid", "indeterminate" as cryptographic
validation is implemented. This is a string enum for schema stability.

SpanJson.description:
JSON representation of a text span.

A span is the smallest unit of extracted text, representing a
contiguous run of text with consistent font and styling.

# TODO: Phase 6.1 - Add confidence_source field

When the `confidence_source` field is added to the schema (per plan line 363, 1662),
it should include "ocr-fallback" as a valid value for spans emitted via
Phase 5.5.3 region-level fallback. The internal `SpanSource::OcrFallback` variant
in `hybrid.rs` maps to this value.

bbox.description:
Bounding box in PDF user-space points.

Format: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` where (x0, y0) is the bottom-left
corner and (x1, y1) is the top-right corner.

column.description:
Column index (0-based) assigned by Phase 4.3 column detection.

This field is `None` for spans outside any detected column
(e.g., full-width headings, inter-column gaps).

confidence.description:
Optional confidence score (0.0 to 1.0).

This field is present when OCR is used or when the extraction
has uncertainty about the text. When confidence is not applicable,
this field is `null`.

receipt.description:
Optional cryptographic receipt for verification.

This field is present when `--receipts=lite` or `--receipts=svg`
is enabled. When receipts are disabled, the field is `null`.

TableJson.description:
JSON representation of a table.

Tables are emitted in parallel with table blocks - the block
provides the concatenated text and position, while the TableJson
provides full cell-level structure.

bbox.description:
Bounding box in PDF user-space points.

Format: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` where (x0, y0) is the bottom-left
corner and (x1, y1) is the top-right corner.

continued.description:
Whether this table continues on the next page.

Set to `true` when a table is split across pages and this
page contains the first part.

continued_from_prev.description:
Whether this table is a continuation from the previous page.

Set to `true` when a table is split across pages and this
page contains a subsequent part.

detection_method.description:
Detection method used to identify this table.

- "line_based": Table detected via ruling lines (borders)
- "borderless": Table detected via x0 alignment heuristics

header_rows.description:
Number of contiguous header rows at the top of the table.

Header rows are typically repeated when tables span multiple pages.

page_index.description: Zero-based page index where this table appears.

rows.description: Rows in this table, ordered top-to-bottom.

BeadJson.description:
A single bead in an article thread chain.

Represents one bead's position on a page, extracted during bead chain walking.
Per PDF 1.7 Section 12.4.3, each bead contains a reference to its page and
a bounding rectangle defining the article region on that page.

page_index.description: 0-based page index where this bead is located.

rect.description:
Bounding rectangle in PDF user-space coordinates [x0, y0, x1, y1].

Per PDF spec, the origin is at the bottom-left corner of the page.
This rect is NOT flipped to image-space coordinates.

ThreadJson.description:
JSON representation of an article thread.

Represents a single article thread from the PDF's /Threads array,
including metadata from the thread info dict (/I) and the complete
bead chain walked from the first bead.

Per the plan (Phase 7.7), threads are extracted and emitted at the
document level in the `/threads` array. The bead chain is walked by
following `/N` (next bead) links from the first bead until termination.

author.description:
Thread author from /I/Author.

- `Some("")` if /I/Author is present but empty string
- `None` if /I is missing or /Author is absent

beads.description:
Beads in this thread chain, in traversal order.

Each bead represents a region on a page that is part of this article.
The beads are ordered by following `/N` (next bead) links from the
first bead through the chain until termination.

keywords.description:
Thread keywords from /I/Keywords.

Per PDF spec, this is a comma-separated convention (not an array).
- `Some("")` if /I/Keywords is present but empty string
- `None` if /I is missing or /Keywords is absent

subject.description:
Thread subject from /I/Subject.

- `Some("")` if /I/Subject is present but empty string
- `None` if /I is missing or /Subject is absent

title.description:
Thread title from /I/Title.

- `Some("")` if /I/Title is present but empty string
- `None` if /I is missing or /Title is absent

description: JSON Schema for pdftract PDF extraction output v1.0. This schema defines the structure of extraction results including pages, spans, blocks, tables, form fields, signatures, and metadata.

form_fields.description:
Interactive form fields extracted from the document.

This array contains all form fields from the AcroForm and/or XFA data.
Fields are sorted alphabetically by name. When both AcroForm and XFA
are present, XFA values take precedence on collision.
Empty when the PDF has no form fields.

links.description:
Hyperlink annotations extracted from the document.

This array contains all link annotations from all pages, sorted
deterministically by page_index and position for stable output.
Empty when the PDF has no link annotations.

attachments.description:
Embedded file attachments extracted from the document.

This array contains all embedded files from the /EmbeddedFiles name tree
or /AF (Associated Files) array. Attachments exceeding 50 MB are
truncated (metadata only, data: null, truncated: true). Empty when the
PDF has no embedded files.

pages.description: Extracted pages, each containing spans and blocks.

signatures.description:
Digital signatures extracted from the document.

This array contains all signature fields discovered in the AcroForm,
including both signed and unsigned (blank) signature fields.
Empty when the PDF has no signature fields.
